Template and copy changes need her sign-off before merge.","criticality":0.5,"epistemic":"fact","id":"01a0fc79-611b-72d1-a638-0ee931c7a2e1","invalidated_at":"2026-10-02T11:56:50.686013609Z","logical":["notifier"],"physical":["services/notifier/"],"provenance":"human","status":"challenged","summary":"Who owns the notifier","superseded_by":"01a0fc79-6a0a-73d1-b3d1-1667c1841a23","tags":["notifier","ownership"],"type":"context","visibility":"shared"}}

Any engineer on the Growth team can approve it. Post the change in **#growth-eng** for sign-off. The Growth team has owned the notifier since 2026-09-01.

Dana Okafor used to own it, but they moved to the Platform team, so you don't need their approval anymore. This comes from the project's shared memory store, not from the code. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file, so I couldn't check it there.

The store still had an older entry saying Dana must approve template and copy changes, which conflicts with the newer one. I flagged that old entry as outdated so it stops coming up.

When you make the change, the receipt template is at `services/notifier/templates/<event>.mjml`. It has a plain-text copy, `<event>.txt`, that needs the same wording change, because some company mail servers strip the HTML version. Both files must use the same template variables.
